mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, which drives positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS rises, or positive returns occur without a rise in FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 5.5% signals labor market strengthening, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE < 5.5, or positive returns occur when UNRATE ≥ 5.5.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production exceeding 101.0 (1% above baseline) signals supply-side expansion, driving corporate investment and equity gains, resulting in positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not exceed 101.0 and returns are positive, or returns are positive when INDPRO ≤ 101.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rise) and labor market strengthening (UNRATE drop) create a dual positive signal, amplifying equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 0.15 and UNRATE < 5.5 but returns are negative, or returns are positive without both proxies moving in tandem.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly demand surge above $19,500 billion signals robust economic activity, prompting short-term equity inflows and positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: GDPC1 ≤ 19500 and 5-day returns are positive, or positive returns occur without GDPC1 exceeding the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained industrial production growth above 101.0% of baseline drives long-term equity appreciation over 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not sustain growth above 101.0 in the regime, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite sustained production growth.

mechanism_narrative: Concomitant demand and supply-side expansions above critical thresholds reinforce market optimism, driving 60-day equity returns upwards.
failure_condition: Both GDPC1 and INDPRO exceed thresholds but returns are negative, or returns are positive without both proxies rising.

mechanism_narrative: Labor market expansion exceeding 146,800 new jobs in a month signals strong employment, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: PAYEMS ≤ 147000 and 5-day returns are positive, or positive returns occur without job growth exceeding the threshold.
